The '''Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader''' (Japanese: '''ヘッドリーダー''' ''Head Leader'') is the title used to address the top-ranked [[Gym Leader]] in the [[Orange League|Orange Crew]]. Only [[Pokémon Trainer]]s skilled enough to earn the four [[Orange League]] [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s are allowed to challenge the Supreme Gym Leader in [[Pummelo Stadium]].

In English, the title is only used in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]] {{pkmn|manga}}. The English [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} refers to the position as the final Gym Leader in the Orange Crew in ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]'' or an Orange League {{pkmn|Champion}} in ''[[EP112|Enter The Dragonite]]''.

==Role==
The Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader serves as the final obstacle in the [[Orange League]]. Those who defeat the Supreme Gym Leader in a [[Full Battle]] earn the [[Winner's Trophy]], become Orange League Honorable Trainers ({{pkmn|Champion}}s in the dub), and are honored in the [[Palace of Victory]].

At the time of {{Ash}}'s [[S02|journey in the Orange Islands]], the Supreme Gym Leader is {{OBP|Drake|Orange League}}. Ash defeated Drake in ''[[EP112|Enter The Dragonite]]''. No other Supreme Gym Leaders have been seen and it is unknown how one rises to this position.

In battle, the Supreme Gym Leader must obey specific rules that give an advantage to the challenger. For example, the Supreme Gym Leader is unable to [[Recall|switch]] {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} mid-battle while the challenger is free to do so at any time.

Although the Supreme Gym Leader occupies a similar position to the Champions of the various [[Pokémon League]]s, they are not displaced upon defeat.
